name: Seth (son of Adam)
title: Ancestor of the godly lineage
summary: Seth was the third son of Adam and Eve, born after Cain had killed Abel. He became the ancestor of the godly line that led to Noah, and through him to all people after the flood. In his time, people began to call on the name of the Lord.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Seth
keyEvents.description: Seth was born after Abel's death as a replacement given by God. Eve said that God had given her another son in place of Abel.

keyEvents.title: Created in Adam's image
keyEvents.description: When Adam was 130 years old, he fathered a son in his own likeness and image, and named him Seth.

keyEvents.title: Father of Enosh
keyEvents.description: Seth became the father of Enosh when he was 105 years old. Enosh became the next link in the godly lineage.

keyEvents.title: The Beginning of Worship
keyEvents.description: In the time of Enosh, son of Seth, people began to call on the name of the Lord. This marks the beginning of organized worship.

keyEvents.title: Seth's Long Life
keyEvents.description: Seth lived 912 years and had more sons and daughters before he died.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Seth is mentioned in Luke's genealogy for Jesus, showing the lineage back to Adam and God.
